landing.sub: Create your own multiplayer world and play with friends.
landing.websiteLine: Everything about the game, downloads and devblog:
landing.how.title: How it works
landing.how.step1: Create a free account (no email needed) and create your own world.
landing.how.step2: Set a join password and share it with your friends.
landing.how.step3: List your world publicly — friends then find it in the world list (here and in the game) and join with your password.
landing.how.hint: There are no open servers: every public world is protected by its creator's password.

landing.signup.hint: The account name is only for signing in — you pick your player name separately and can change it anytime. No email needed. Write down your account name, password and rescue codes! A rescue code lets you reset a forgotten password.

landing.codes.hint: Write these codes on paper! A code lets you set a new password if you forget yours. Each code works once — they are never shown again.

rules.intro: Blocks Beyond the Stars is a family and community project. Kids and grown-ups play here together — be kind to each other!
rules.item1: 🧒 Please ask your parents first if it is okay for you to play this game.
rules.item2: Be friendly and help other players.
rules.item3: Build, explore and invent — don't destroy on purpose what others have built.
rules.item4: No hate speech, no bullying, no racism, no insults — not in chat, names or builds. Such violations lead to an immediate ban, no warning.
rules.item5: Never share personal data (real name, address, school …) and don't ask others for theirs.
rules.item6: Saw something bad? Report it right in the game: type /report <name> in chat or use the report button in the player list (ship → alliance) — or the form on the worlds page. We review every report.
rules.beta.label: Beta notice:
rules.beta.text: the game and its hosted worlds are a beta. Worlds and saves can break or disappear at any time. Download a backup of your world regularly if it matters to you!
legal.germanOnly: This legal notice is required by German law (§ 5 DDG) and is therefore provided in German.
legal.notConfigured: The operator of this (self-hosted) portal has not configured their legal notice yet (BBS_WH_LEGAL_NAME / _ADDRESS / _EMAIL).
legal.beta.title: Beta service
legal.beta.text: This worlds portal is a free hobby and family project in beta. There is no entitlement to availability or data retention — worlds and saves can be lost at any time (use the backup feature!).
privacy.summary.title: Privacy in short
privacy.summary.text: This service is deliberately data-minimal: a self-chosen account name, a password hash (never the password), your worlds and your reports/feedback — no email, no real name, no ads, no tracking, no third-party embeds. IPs are held transiently for rate limiting and in routine server logs only. Hosting is in Germany; nothing is shared or sold. Short in-game NPC texts are generated by an LLM at OVHcloud (EU) — only the moment's game context (e.g. your in-world player name, the NPC and the situation) is sent, never account data or IPs, and built-in fallback texts take over if it is unavailable. Deleting your account (button on the worlds page) permanently removes the account, sessions, your reports and all your worlds including saves. For any privacy request, email the address above. The German text below is the authoritative version.
